permitDetails.rightOfEntryClause:
21. Right of Entry - The permittee shall allow authorized local, state, and federal
representatives, upon the presentation of credentials:

a.
To enter upon the permittee's premises on which the facility is located or in which any
records are required to be kept under the terms and conditions of this permit;

b.
To have access to and copy at reasonable times any records required to be kept under
the terms and conditions of this permit or the State Air Pollution Control Board
Regulations;

c.
To inspect at reasonable times any facility, equipment, or process subject to the terms
and conditions of this permit or the State Air Pollution Control Board Regulations;
and

d.
To sample or test at reasonable times.

For purposes of this condition, the time for inspection shall be deemed reasonable during
regular business hours or whenever the facility is in operation.  Nothing contained herein
shall make an inspection time unreasonable during an emergency.
(9 VAC 5-170-130 and 9 VAC 5-80-1180)

generatorSets.control_technologies: Turbocharged engine and aftercooler/charge air cooler
generatorSets.operatingHoursRollingWindow: Consecutive 12-month rolling period, calculated monthly by summing the most recently completed calendar month with the preceding 11 months.
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: Emergency situations where the primary energy/power source is disrupted or disconnected due to conditions beyond the owner/operator’s control (including electrical grid failure, on-site disaster or equipment failure, and public service emergencies such as flood, fire, natural disaster, or severe weather); participation in an ISO-declared emergency (including abnormal system conditions requiring action to maintain reliability/safety, capacity deficiency or excess, fuel shortages requiring conservation, abnormal natural events or man-made threats requiring conservative operations, or abnormal events external to the ISO territory requiring ISO action); periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training; and non-emergency (alternate) power generation only if documentation is submitted and DEQ approval is received for the change in method of operation.

generatorSets.operatingHoursRollingWindow: Consecutive 12-month rolling period, calculated monthly; compliance demonstrated by summing the most recently completed calendar month plus the previous 11 months.
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: Emergency power generation in sudden and reasonably unforeseeable events disrupting the primary energy/power source (including grid failure, on-site disaster or equipment failure, and public service emergencies such as flood, fire, natural disaster, or severe weather); participation in an ISO-declared emergency (abnormal system conditions, capacity deficiency or excess, fuel shortage requiring departure from normal procedures, abnormal natural events or man-made threats requiring conservative operations, or abnormal external events that may require ISO action); periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training. Any change to non-emergency (alternate) power generation requires prior DEQ approval.

generatorSets.operatingHoursRollingWindow: Calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period; compliance demonstrated monthly by adding the total for the most recently completed calendar month to the individual monthly totals for the preceding 11 months.
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: Emergency power generation due to sudden and unforeseeable disruptions beyond the owner/operator’s control (including electrical grid failure; on-site disaster or equipment failure; and public service emergencies such as flood, fire, natural disaster, or severe weather), participation in an ISO-declared emergency, and periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training; any change to non-emergency (alternate) power generation requires prior DEQ approval.

generatorSets.control_technologies: Turbocharged engine and aftercooler/charge air cooler; good operating practices and appropriate maintenance (per manufacturer recommendations)
generatorSets.operatingHoursRollingWindow: Consecutive 12-month rolling period calculated monthly; each month, add the most recently completed calendar month to the totals for the preceding 11 months to demonstrate compliance.
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: Emergency power generation during sudden, unforeseeable disruptions to the primary power source (including electrical grid failure, on-site disaster or equipment failure, and public service emergencies such as flood, fire, natural disaster, or severe weather); participation in an ISO-declared emergency; and periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training.
